title: Sleepy commits own runtime state onto ticket branch, then denylist-deletes it and crashes
source_context: JustFacts sleepy run 2026-07-06 06:43, died op iter 1 met KeyError
description: Chain: sleepy start writes .cto/sleepy/config.json+budget.json (untracked) -> ensure_clean does git add -A on the ticket branch and sweeps them in -> denylist .cto/sleepy/** flags the branch -> branch deleted, state files vanish from disk on checkout -> next iteration load_json returns {} -> KeyError: 'iteration' and the supervisor dies after iter 1. Hotfixed in place 2026-07-06: (1) git add -A -- . ':(exclude).cto/sleepy' + nothing-staged => clean; (2) git clean -fd -e .cto/sleepy in discard path; (3) cfg.get('iteration',0) guard + fallback to in-memory cfg/bud. Prometheus should review the hotfix and add a regression test.
proposed_changes: Hotfix al toegepast in sleepy.py; valideren + test toevoegen

triage.evidence: Fix present: scripts/sleepy.py:194 git add -A -- . ':(exclude).cto/sleepy'; :195-197 staged-empty => "clean"; :205 git clean -fd -e .cto/sleepy; :575-577 load_json(...) or cfg fallback and cfg.get("iteration", 0) + 1. Test still missing: find over repo for test* files matches only agents/tester-morty.json — no tests/ dir, no pytest infra, no coverage of sanitize_worktree.
triage.note: The crash itself was hotfixed before filing and the fix is intact post-b680ed9, but the proposal's deliverable was 'validate + add regression test' and no regression test exists — the repo has zero test files. Remaining scope: one new test file covering sanitize_worktree() (exclude pathspec, nothing-staged short-circuit, clean -e .cto/sleepy, iteration guard) using a temp git repo fixture. Does not touch scripts/prometheus.py. Impact is moderate not critical: it prevents re-regression of a crash that already caused two incidents (2026-07-06 and 2026-07-07..13), but the runtime bug is gone.
